text: Yes! A healthy juice place that is convenient and easy to order and pay using an app on my phone. It's not going to be for everyone - but if you are into juicing it's a great place to visit. I can't vouch for the food / salads but the pre made juices are always fresh and tasty. It is a bit expensive, but for quality ingredients I think it's worth it.

We were on the NW side so thought we'd give this place a try. Their stuff at the Greek fest was good so go to the source right? Large portions couldn't make up for what was, at best, food court worthy fair. Dry, underwhelming gyro, pizza dough "pita", and something off with the baklava (not as flaky tender as I was expecting). Wouldn't make a special trip from our home on the east side, and will be bypassing for something else when we're up this way again.

What a great place to bike to in the eagle area. A friend of mine introduced me to this place and I loved it! They have an amazing bakery for breakfast and delicious burgers for lunch. Workers were very nice. Definitely will return
Excellent. Everything from their delicious breakfast to the baristas creations. Frequently get the platter breakfast. One of my favorite breakfast spots to eat.

They need more help in the mornings. Between waiting to order and waiting to get my coffee and bagel - 20 minutes. And I went inside for the carry out because the drive thru line was too long. And I got the bagel long before I got the coffee.

Ordered to-go: muffuletta was fine but I've had much better, I personally like when the olive salad seeps into the bottom bun but that didn't happen here, it was pretty dry. The debris fries were just okay, would've been better with a side of ranch.

Not the biggest fan of casinos but I had time to kill and it was the only game in town. Nothing special about gambling in this place, especially compared to big casinos for other cities. I'd recommend to check it out as long as you're in the neighborhood.

The one star review on here is a bunch of crap. What a great local story. Doug and Brewmaster Dan have done a fantastic job representing Reno and providing yet another craft brew for us locals to enjoy. Patti does a GREAT job serving up thirsty fans at the brewery, which has a ton of character, cheap beers, new batches to try, darts, and a huge wall collection of beers from around the world. Oh, and the beer? It's tasty, the menu is growing and so is Dan's talent.

I keep on getting fooled by pictures of hotels on the internet. Online, this place looks awesome, in person, there are tiny, tiny rooms and a ghetto alleyway where you park your car and go to your room. Also, the walls are paper thin. My husband (then boyfriend) and I stayed here for Valentine's Day and the couple next door were fighting all morning. We could hear the woman screaming and (what sounded like) throwing things around the room. We could also hear the man pounding on the door and yelling at her. It was actually kind of scary. The cops eventually came, but by then we were already up and couldn't get back to sleep.

Believe it or not I prefer the experiences and meals I've had here to the higher end Harvest Room. The service is always bang on. The food, while simple, is dead one 9 times out of 10 (had butter chicken once that was crummy). I keep coming here because I love the super comfy chairs, atmospheric room, fab fireplace and ultra friendly & professional staff. If you think about it, burger and a drink for $25 with all the service & quality this place offers - it's the best deal in town.

This hop on hop off tour was fine except for one thing, the buses didn't come around often enough. While we waited at the initial stop to get on, we saw 3 of the Old Time Trolley buses come and go. We waited about 20-25 mins. We saw the other company's buses a lot, but ours not so much. We didn't want to get off for fear of not being able to get back on in a timely manner. Do yourself a favor and go with the other company!

Smelled good, clean inside, this place should be good, right? Nope. Confusing menu and when I ordered they served the wrong entree. No problem, they fixed it. Then, the prices don't match the menu. Way over charged for what it should cost. We started eating our food and "this is interesting"... Nothing tasted like it should. The spices were all wrong, dairy in what was claimed a vegetarian salad, just... underwhelming. The corner store sells dog food and at least you know what you are getting there. Needles to say, I will not be back.

The owners of this place are awful. In summer of 2020 they fired employees for participating in protests, posting about Black Lives Matter on their personal social medias, etc. Do not give these people your money.

This place was just... okay. I really could have done without seeing this place. It was kind of cool seeing some of Andrew Jacksons things but it was really boring. Many people we passed though the first main building were just sitting on benches on their phones. The actual mansion wasn't impressive at all. The tour guides were very informative but we were only allowed in the hallways and the rest of the rooms were viewed behind pieces of glass. The only thing here that I was actually interested in was where Andrew and the rest of his family was buried in the yard. It was in a flower garden next to his wife in a monument.
Great customer service with an excellent product! Nobody does it like the Human Bean! This is my go-to for hot and cold drinks.

Terrible hotel! The rooms are ancient and not well kept. The walls are paper thin and you can hear everything in the neighboring room. For the amount of money per night it's just not worth it. Look elsewhere! I wish we did! Lesson learned.

I'm an angry mom! I went into epic the other day with my daughter. But we left immediately because my daughter was afraid of Alexis. S, I found out your employee Is harassing my daughter Via Facebook. That is pathetic. Why would you hire a person like that? To hell with that.

I had VERY high expectations after seeing this little shop on Cupcake Wars, so unfortunately, because they were so high, I was a bit disappointed. I had the cookies n cream cupcake; it was good, but not out of this world like I was expecting. Maybe I should have tried a different kind. The shop itself is very cute with nice seating areas. I will most likely give this place another try the next time I'm in town.

My favorite coffeehouse in Tampa, hands-down! It has such a warm atmosphere, it makes you feel right at home each time you walk through the door! It's hard to go anywhere else after having their coffee and kick myself when I try.

(3.75) ~ Good Overall Natural Foods Grocery Store. Note: It's similar to Whole Foods, but with a greater emphasis on Plant Based Products and less meat. Pretty good selection of supplements for a Grocery store. And the star of the show is their Produce section;)

The staff is very kind, the room so dusty, the mattress little old, food is great thougha little pricey. One more thing, my room doesn't have sound proof windows, I heard the highway noise the whole night.

Hate this airline. Very rude and difficult. Questioned my grandmother regarding why she needed a service animal. She nearly missed her flight. They need to be more sensitive to people with disabilities!

I ordered a hot chocolate for my wife and I. By definition, hot chocolate is hot and has a good chocolate taste. Unfortunately, it was not hot and the chocolate taste was weak. I guess you should try the coffee. As an aside, the place was packed with hipsters and their computers. I don't see how the coffee shop can make money with this crowd stuffing the tables for hours. Oh well. That's their problem.

Only giving 3 stars because of the service. Maybe I didn't order the right thing but I had the vegetable soup which was sweet too sweet for me it almost tasted like it had lotion in it! Then I had a roti which had ground chick peas in it maybe I'll try another dish another time but I didn't care for it

If you're looking for an authentic Asian grocery store, this is the place. They have things here I have never seen any other grocery store. When I'm on this side of town I come in for specific things I cannot buy anywhere else. Everything I see is so fresh. You have to give them a try.

Wow, this place is a gem!! A beautiful little shotgun on a quiet corner in the Treme. Great coffee, delicious pastries, and absolutely scrumptious Mediterranean breakfast! I went with the family, so we sat in the front room and chatted, but there was also a very quiet back room that would be ideal for studying and sipping coffee.

Chose this place on a whim for coffee with a good friend before the holidays. I was pleased to find it warm and inviting with friendly staff. I had an iced tea which was very good. That's a high compliment coming from a Southerner. We take iced tea very seriously. My friend had a Chai Tea which she also enjoyed. I also appreciated the fact that you got one free refill on the iced tea. I'll certainly be back.
First of all, Louis Armstrong was not actually here. But check in was quick and relatively painless (was only bitten twice by TSA zombies) and there was a solid selection of food.

Amazingly fluffy and tasty kolaches. When you bite into them you taste the homemadeness instead of the prepackaged as with many breakfast places today. My go-to spot on the east side when I'm looking for something semi-quick.

First visit since the move. I had the burger, disappointing. Friends ordered breakfast items and seem ok. Just not the same attention to detail with regard to the quality of the food and prep. Unfortunately not a lot of choices at 10pm in St. Louis to eat.

It's always those tiny little holes in the wall where you discover something special, The menu is small and simple and they perfect the few menu items that they have. They definitely got a regular customer of me

It is what it is- a cheap place to stay for a short period of time. It is loud all throughout the night and the walls are super thin so you hear everything. The beds are uncomfortable and the rooms are not that great or clean. However, I needed this room just to "sh*t, shower and shave" so it was perfect for that. I might consider staying again for a short period of time. It was also a short Lyft to French Quarters and walking distance to some cute stores and restaurants.

I took my mom to Davis Island from New York. We decided to go to Fountain Square because it looked like it had a cool fun atmosphere. However it took us 15 to be greeted, and then we got our drinks, ordered and after an hour left because we still had not received our appetizer. Horrible service horrible everything. I was embarrassed that I brought my mom here bragging how lovely Davis Island was.

This place is terrible. Every room smells like someone puked on the floor and then they tried to clean it up but failed but still left the carpets wet with toxic cleaning agents. Management has been unhelpful and at times rude. It was so bad we left our room at 1:30 am to switch hotels. Oh and it's the weekend of our wedding so we also brought about 60 other rooms of business to this fourth rate sh!thole. I can't stress enough that you should stay away. Terrible establishment. Disgusting. Avoid. Seriously.

Great selection of spices but I'm glad I only bought oregano. I asked if it was from Greece and they told me yes. Maybe from Greece 2 years ago. When I smash it with my fingers I can't even smell oregano. Not fresh, not happy. I went on a tour and they took us here. Very disappointed. Ruined my soup!!!

Slowest, most non-customer service oriented Starbucks I've ever visited. Only 1 person was making drinks and the priority seemed to be the drive through lane. This is the most inefficient process/approach I've ever seen in a Starbucks. I visited this location on multiple days and different times during the day, always to find the same inefficient service. During my afternoon visits, the personnel were definitely not focussed on getting folks served and out the door...unbelievably slow!

Great beer. Love their cubano, smoked chicken wings, and jalapeño ranch salad dressing. Kindest, most attentive folks working there. They have even held our fussy baby so we could eat our lunch. I love this place!

Worst rental car experience ever, possibly the worst interaction I have ever had with a business. Waited 1 hour in the line only to be told they did not have the class of car they reserved me, but could rent me something else for much, much more $$. Took another 45 minutes arguing with the attendant (Vijay) that I did not want to pay more than the original reservation, did not want to buy all his "extras". In the end, I lost 2 hours, and was pretty frustrated. I wish I had looked at all the bad reviews before I made the reservation. BEWARE BEWARE BEWARE!!!!!!!! Rent from someone with a better reputation!!!

So disappointed!! Awful fish to rice ratio. Also the rolls were super messy. Half of the small amoint of fish was on the bottom of the roll. Unfortunately won't be ordering from here again. There are much better sushi options in the city.

We had the worst check in experience ever. Beyond rude. We travel to Santa Barbara once a month and our favorite inn was booked. Chad was flat out rude and has never heard the word customer service. He refused to check our reservation by phone (we didn't have our confirmation in hand when we called) and although the room was pre-paid he insisted it was not was not about to put himself out to find out the problem. When he did find the information he did not apologize. Awful first impression. The room was clean, but dated, the view was great, the grounds were nice, but we will not stay here again.
